purpose: Correct the Stage-5 corridor topology while preserving the prior SA5 recipe and original parent.
authorization_limit: This protocol authorizes SA5-R2 training and checkpoint creation only; it cannot accept an SA5 parent or launch SA6.

environment_behavior_diff: physical corridor side-wall span changes from the legacy 10 m to the 15 m Stage-5 room span
each side wall overlaps each north/south boundary wall by 0.5 m

known_initial_behavior.evidence_level: qualitative GUI observation with quantitative wall-collision support from one fixed cell
known_initial_behavior.observation: A legacy SA5 policy initially steers toward a former corridor end gap and collides with the newly sealed wall corner.
known_initial_behavior.interpretation_limit: This supports learned use of the legacy bypass in that checkpoint; it does not by itself prove the exact SA4-R3 parent has the same behavior.

parent.caveat: The parent has earlier legacy corridor exposure; this is a warm-start correction, not a from-scratch clean baseline.

pre_training_baseline_requirement.checkpoint: the exact frozen SA4-R3 conceptual-it125 parent
pre_training_baseline_requirement.purpose: Measure inherited sealed-corridor behavior before any SA5-R2 update so correction can be attributed to training rather than checkpoint choice.
pre_training_baseline_requirement.acceptance_effect: Diagnostic baseline only; it cannot accept or reject the training lineage by itself.

post_training_requirement: Select checkpoints with fixed sealed lateral, longitudinal, random-2d and mixed corridor screens, then verify native and narrow retention. Training metrics cannot accept a parent.
